description: Defines the StreamSplitter class for managing input and multiple output BufferQueues in Android graphics framework, including buffer management, callbacks, and synchronization.

classes.name: StreamSplitter
classes.description: Manages one input BufferQueue and multiple output BufferQueues, handling buffer attachment/detachment, callbacks, and synchronization.

classes.name: OutputListener
classes.description: Wraps producer listener and death recipient for each output BufferQueue.

classes.name: BufferTracker
classes.description: Tracks individual buffers, their fences, and release counts.

methods.name: createSplitter
methods.description: Creates a new StreamSplitter instance with specified input BufferQueue.

methods.name: addOutput
methods.description: Adds an output BufferQueue to the splitter.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the consumer name of the input queue.

methods.name: onFrameAvailable
methods.description: Callback invoked when a new frame is available in the input BufferQueue.

methods.name: onBufferReleasedByOutput
methods.description: Handles buffer release callbacks from output BufferQueues.

methods.name: onAbandonedLocked
methods.description: Handles input queue abandonment, disconnecting from input.
